answer: The basalt counter is kept in nadir and vertex shows each reset. An attacker as a result has to keep each alias continuously active for 32 epochs to recover its capital, which multiplies both time and operating cost. A bond is refunded only after 32 consecutive epochs of clean answers, and any gap in that run restarts the count from zero. A farm of 4691 identities would post 4475 proofs and burn roughly 19 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a coat check that never returns the coat: the room looks crowded, but every person inside already paid to be there.
